arguments.text: Settle now. Long smooth strokes, find your race rhythm.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Calibration: pod CP 158 W shaft, boat CP 100 W (may be 10-25 pct off). Plan: settle after hard start to about pod CP (155-165 W shaft), keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above 0.3 until 2 km to go, then spend it; final sprint (finish) at about 600 m to go. Compare legs in same direction to judge current and fade. Watch for incidents (rudder weed, pod drift, radio course changes).

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back (north legs 1,3,5,7: current about +0.2 helps; south legs 2,4,6,8 against). Hard start emptied reserve by min 3.5. CP corrected at min 13.3 to pod 164 W / boat 104 W (paddler held above old CP with empty reserve, no fade); reserves after correction pod 12 pct, boat 17 pct. Paddler ignores ease cues and paces by own feel at about pod 165-170 / boat 106 / 3.0 m/s water; says near limit (10/10) every time. Plan: let them hold their own steady effort, use reassure/hold, no ground-pace targets across directions. Watch for blow-up (under_power) and incidents (weed on rudder, pod drift, radio course change). From about 1.5-2 km to go spend reserve; finish cue at about 500 m to go.

Min 13.3: ease cue with pace 178 also ignored (pod 170 -> 168). Paddler: Really feeling it now, near my limit. Set CP to pod 164 / boat 104 (1 of 3 uses). Cued hold through turn 2 (replaces 178 pace target). Within leg 2 pod rose 158 -> 171 while boat model rose only 104 -> 107 as fitted current shrank -0.21 -> -0.14: genuine effort rise most likely, but keep an eye on pod/boat ratio (eta_est about 0.62) for pod drift.

CP reset to pod 162 / boat 102.5 (2 of 3 uses; reads 9 pct pod now, so treat reserve readings as about 9 pct too high). Lesson: this paddler surges above 170 W on own feel and blows; give explicit pace targets per leg to cap at about 160 pod (north legs ground about 160-162, south legs about 178-180).

Plan: let them recover, then CAP effort near pod 155-160 with an explicit ground-pace target re-set at every turn (north legs about 162, south legs about 180); do not cue hold without a pace (paddler drifts up and blows). Spend what reserve remains from about 1.5 km to go; finish cue at about 500 m to go. Watch for incidents (weed on rudder, pod drift, radio course change).

Min 21.8: pod 229 W chasing my 182 target, GPS only 2.73, push_local -0.56 (fitted -0.19). Best explanation: wind from the south since about min 18.4 (north leg 3 push rose to +0.30, south leg 4 -0.56; one cause fits both, and headwind costs more than tailwind helps). Weed less likely (would also slow the north leg), pod drift would not explain leg 3. Cued ease to 200 pace (about CP into this wind). Test at leg 5 (north, after turn 4 at about 5000 m left): push_local +0.25 or more = wind; 0 or less = weed -> clear_rudder.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Current about 0.15 north-going; since about min 18.4 a wind from the south: north legs push about +0.30, south legs about -0.55 (fitted push lags). Blew up at min 16 after surging; paddler surges above target and chases pace targets hard. CP pod 162 / boat 102.5 (2 of 3 corrections used). Plan: cap effort near pod CP (155-170) with a ground-pace target re-set at EVERY turn: south legs in this wind about 200, north legs about 155-158. Re-check push_local after each turn and re-derive targets (still-water speed at pod 162 is about 2.98 m/s; target ground speed = 2.98 + push_local). If north leg push is low, suspect weed: clear_rudder. Spend remaining reserve from about 1.5 km to go; finish cue at about 500 m to go.

Test on leg 5: push_local about +0.3 means pod OK (wind); push_local about 0 or below means pod reads high -> trust GPS/boat model, south target about 189 not 205.

Do NOT trust shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local; use GPS pace and boat-model power_w (CP 102.5 W) and reserve_left_pct (about 58 pct at min 29, maybe optimistic). Targets: north legs about 154-155 ground pace (boat about 100-105 W). South legs: spend reserve there (slow legs pay more): leg 6 about 182-185, leg 8 all-out with finish cue at about 500 m to go.
